name: Background remover (flat backgrounds)
Engine: Plain JavaScript in your browser (no engine binary)
description: Flood-fill the border colour to transparent with a tolerance slider. A colour-key cutout for studio, product and document shots — no AI model, no upload.

seo.metaTitle: Background remover (flat backgrounds) — free in your browser, no upload | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Remove a flat or near-solid image background to transparent PNG in your browser. Edge flood fill with a tolerance slider — no AI model, no upload, no account.
seo.aeoSummary: This background remover cuts out a solid or near-solid background with an edge flood fill inside your browser tab. No model is downloaded, no photo is uploaded, and nothing is sent anywhere.

faqs.question: Does this tool upload my files my files or text to a server?
faqs.answer: No. The cutout runs with a flood fill over the pixels of your own image inside this tab; the file is never uploaded and no model is downloaded.

faqs.question: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate AI background remover?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/bg_remove.json or open /tools/bg-remove?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.

steps: Select or drop your image into the browser workspace.
Configure processing parameters and preview the updated image in real time.
Download your final processed image directly to your device with 0 server uploads.

desc: Flood-fills the border colour from the edges and makes it transparent, with a tolerance slider. Built for studio, product and document shots on a plain background — it is a colour-key cutout, not an AI matting model, and it will not trace hair.
wasmModule: none (colour-key flood fill, no engine binary)
